items.title: Expanding our partnership with Cognizant
items.summary: Cognizant embeds Claude across its platforms, with 30,000+ associates trained, and becomes a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network.

items.title: Import AI 466: The bitter lesson for robotics, AIs complete week-long programming tasks; and OpenAI’s accidental AI hacker
items.summary: Welcome to Import AI, a newsletter about AI research. Import AI runs on arXiv, cappuccinos, and feedback from readers. If you’d like to support this, please subscribe. Subscribe now Epoch and METR release MirrorCode, a benchmark for seeing how well AI systems can do long-horizon programming tasks: …AI systems can’t solve the hardest tasks yet (good!)… Epoch and METR have released MirrorCode, a benchmark meant to see
items.summaryZh: Epoch与METR正式推出了MirrorCode基准测试，旨在评估AI系统在没有原始源码和网络访问情况下、完全通过命令行界面完成长周期复杂软件重构的能力。测试目标包含多款数万行代码的真实程序，结果显示当前顶级模型已展现出处理数小时至十数小时级复杂编程任务的潜力。
